requirements: Is there exactly one image showing a 4x4 grid of 16 items?
Are there exactly 16 distinct objects with one in each grid cell?
Are the 16 objects arranged left to right and top to bottom in the exact order given in the list?
Is each object complete, centered in its cell, and filling about 70 percent of the cell?
Does each object have at least 12 percent empty margin on every side with nothing touching or crossing any cell edge?
Do no objects overlap with each other?
Is the first item a folded tan pier vest with more pockets?
Is the second item a grey heated seat cushion with a cord and a warm glow?
Is the third item an open tackle box showing three layers of lures with a few red peppers in a corner?
Is the sixth item a big wooden pepper mill shaped like a small cannon with a pepper cloud coming out?
